The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3727 kṣura explicitly includes the churī “knife” family through Prakrit chura/churī and notes that ch-forms spread across dialect boundaries. The survey churi/curi forms therefore receive qualified family links, without a claim of uninterrupted local inheritance. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.

Nearby kholi/khor forms can be linked provisionally to this defective-word family while the local extension and transmission remain open.
